findings.issue_summary: Play Console Declaration Required for Foreground Service
findings.evidence: Foreground service WearableStreamingService is declared in AndroidManifest.xml and started in WearableStreamingService.kt.
findings.recommendation: For apps targeting Android 14+, you must complete a Foreground Service declaration in the Play Console (App content section) for each type used, providing a functional description, user impact video, and a specific use case selection.

findings.evidence: In MainViewModel.kt, startRecording() initiates a continuous AudioRecord read loop inside a viewModelScope. This loop is not tied to the activity lifecycle and can remain active when the app is minimized without an explicit user-facing recording indicator.
findings.recommendation: Tie the recording loop to the app's UI lifecycle to pause capture when minimized, or ensure the ongoing recording is backed by a Foreground Service with an explicit 'recording in progress' notification.
